bench_io_lazy_sequence_expression.title: Lazy sequence expression — eager versus deferred materialization
bench_io_lazy_sequence_expression.description: Single DOC0377 case comparing eager materialize-each-step with one deferred canonical-facade nested slice/concat expression.

test_case_descriptions.FASTQ_REAL_HUMAN_FASTQ_6GB: Real-data FASTQ: ~6 GiB. Reader-only: it is a dna5 corpus (contains N) and the bench's dna4 reader silently drops N's, so byte-faithful roundtrip is not achievable through the dna4 alphabet. Throughput numbers from the reader path are still meaningful.
test_case_descriptions.FASTQ_REAL_HUMAN_FASTQ_GZ: Real-data FASTQ.gz: ~1.96 GiB compressed. Reader-only — see FASTQ_REAL_HUMAN_FASTQ_6GB note.
test_case_descriptions.FASTA_IDENTIFIER_UNIPROT_SHORT: ~9 MiB FASTA of ~200 bp records with UniProt-like metadata headers
test_case_descriptions.LAZY_SEQUENCE_EXPRESSION_8M: 8 Mi-bp deterministic DNA4 nested slice/concat expression
